$comment: Accepted npm audit advisories (m1-009). Checked by scripts/audit-check.mjs in CI. One entry per advisory (GHSA ID). For high and critical advisories, `affects` lists every package npm flagged through that advisory when it was accepted; a new package means a new dependency path and fails CI. reviewBy is at most maxReviewDays after accepted; an expired entry fails CI until it is re-decided. Re-decided under D-M0-5 (S5/S6) in m1-011. Never use `npm audit fix --force`: it would downgrade apostrophe to 3.x and nodemon to 1.x.
auditSummary: 43 package findings (38 moderate, 5 high, 0 critical) from 3 advisories (1 high, 2 moderate). Production-only (--omit=dev): 42 findings, 4 high.

advisories.title: braces vulnerable to stack-exhaustion denial of service through deeply nested patterns
advisories.scope: prod (apostrophe -> chokidar -> braces; nunjucks also lists chokidar) and dev (nodemon -> chokidar -> braces)
advisories.reason: No braces release outside the affected range (<=3.0.3) is available to this tree; npm's only fix is a semver-major downgrade of apostrophe (to 3.x) and nodemon (to 1.x). apostrophe uses chokidar to watch view and asset directories during development; the watched glob patterns come from the application, not from visitors. nodemon runs on developer machines only.
advisories.remediation: m1-011: check for a patched braces or chokidar line and whether an npm override is safe; otherwise re-accept with a new date

advisories.title: Tiptap: mergeAttributes() turns an own __proto__ key into inherited executable DOM attributes
advisories.scope: prod (apostrophe rich-text editor, admin UI only)
advisories.reason: apostrophe 4.34.0 depends on Tiptap 2.x (@tiptap/starter-kit ^2.27.2) for the rich-text editor, which only logged-in editors load. The advisory is fixed in Tiptap 3.30.4, outside apostrophe's supported range.
advisories.remediation: m1-011: upgrade when an apostrophe release moves to a fixed Tiptap line; review editor role access (D-M0-11)

advisories.title: sprintf-js vulnerable to denial of service through unbounded precision specifiers
advisories.reason: Reached through underscore.string inside apostrophe core; format strings come from code, not from visitors. No compatible fixed release in this tree.
advisories.remediation: m1-011: re-check with the next apostrophe release
